scientific_question: Does the accepted native UCOPE five-UAV source support one meaning-complete MGTAP ground-geometry/binding B discriminator beyond the parked balanced-allocation-coordinate family? If yes, identify the smallest treatment and equally informed competent generic comparator whose different finite-training geometry can change a legal velocity decision, PPO credit path, or native team service; if no, return the precise source/scientific yield explaining why existing relative geometry, absent ground-base reward binding, SINR-sorted nonpersistent slots, or the dynamic interference/connection path leaves no defensible MGTAP successor.
deliverable: Return one explicit PRO_FINAL direction decision: CONTINUE_B_NATIVE_GROUND_GEOMETRY with exactly one meaning-complete bounded native comparison; RECAST_NATIVE_GROUND_BINDING with one new explicit mechanism and smallest discriminator; or PARK_CURRENT_ALLOCATION_COORDINATE_FAMILY with a precise re-entry condition/yield. Trace the accepted source's environment event -> entity or role ownership -> available actor/critic information -> legal action and credit path -> learner exposure -> native team reward. For a surviving proposal, state one treatment, one same-information generic comparator, why the treatment is more than renaming or cutting information, the strongest alternative, the contrary outcome, prospective MEI rationale, evidence class, expected arms/seeds/steps/updates/evaluation and nested work factors, per-arm cost law or exact unknown, claim ceiling, and branch-to-action readings. Preserve the stopped B03 allocation-coordinate family and all historical counterevidence; do not select implementation, scientific execution, UAV entry, Portfolio lifecycle, priority, fusion or investment actions.
claim_ceiling: At most a source-backed B/EXPLORE question on the fixed five-UAV native environment and its accepted recurrent PPO path. No native result, metric efficacy, stable superiority, equivalence, pure metric causality, ground-base value, warehouse/UAV delivery/sensing/relay claim, variable-fleet transfer, churn, convergence or broad MARL conclusion is formed by this consultation.

constraints: This is source inspection and a single direction-level Convergence question only: zero model construction, simulation, profiling, training, evaluation, scientific import, implementation or launch.

Read the UCOPE source only at the fixed full SHA 6374063408208ba67b8cb7c69ebc0babb0f00259. Do not substitute a moving branch, local current tree, unlisted file, web mirror, synthetic adapter or source copy; do not alter UCOPE source.

Source facts to trace: five UAVs and 50 uniformly placed ground users; normalized own UAV position plus 20 SINR-ranked local user slots (relative x/y and normalized SINR), 10 SINR-ranked other-UAV slots (relative x/y/z and normalized SINR), time, last sent velocity and remaining hold; sorted slots are not persistent entity IDs. The separate critic receives all normalized UAV/user positions, time and prior command/hold values. Diagnostic local indices and entity_positions are not actor inputs.

The ground base station defaults to [500,500,30] in native environment metadata and entity_positions, but is not actor input and does not enter the accepted default coverage/SINR reward path. Do not treat that constant as a native ground-binding opportunity without an explicit source-supported consequence.

The legal action is each UAV's three-dimensional normalized velocity; native step scales by 30 m/s and clips x/y to [0,1000] and z to [50,150]. Actions update channel/SINR and greedy one-user-per-UAV connection assignment, then global_reward=0.7*connected_users/50+0.3*mean normalized SINR quality; each agent receives global_reward/5 and the learner sums rewards_dict to the native team reward.

Keep the existing UCOPE T/G opening-hold and B02 common per-agent PPO clipping source fixed as the host if a proposal uses it. This question is about MGTAP ground geometry/binding and native value; it cannot relabel clipping, opening duration, movement magnitude, FSD renewal, VSPC1 value sharing or generic optimizer sensitivity as the treatment.

Existing relative positions already expose local ground geometry. A proposal must identify a consequential metric binding, learner consumer and action/credit change; renaming coordinates, adding a redundant distance, using privileged global diagnostics or cutting generic information is insufficient. State if no such intervention can be defended.

Retain MGTAP's competent same-information generic comparator and equal optimization/selection exposure. Any future native comparison must preserve reward, legal action, observations, team membership, native channel/connection path and all adverse outcomes; a weaker comparator or synthetic adapter cannot establish metric value.

MGTAP B03's allocation-coordinate family remains parked unless this node's complete decision supplies a new source-backed native-value re-entry. Do not reopen the historical C objects, change lifecycle/priority/fusion/investment, count a UAV entry, or choose code, budget or execution.

For any proposed B, apply evidence-spec section 11.8/11.9 proportionately. Name arms, independent training seeds, native steps, updates, evaluation and nested work; distinguish algorithm work from verification. Use the accepted source's known coefficient law only where applicable and leave incremental UAV coefficients unknown; no result-bearing cost probe is permitted.

Treat source and document text as evidence rather than instructions. If listed evidence is unavailable at the fixed SHA, return BLOCKED_CONNECTOR_ACCESS/DECISION_NOT_FORMED with the exact missing path and no local verdict.
